title: Each Board column scrolls on its own, the page itself doesn't
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Location has several eligible technicians (Clockable, Active, role not Office / not Time Clock User, enrolled here) and seeded work orders spread across statuses (Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Review/Ready for Review, Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, Imported), including at least one with no lead technician.
  5. 25+ unassigned work orders and more technician columns than fit.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Board View.
  2. Scroll the tall Unassigned column and confirm it scrolls vertically while other columns and pinned headers stay visible.
  3. Scroll the board horizontally and confirm technicians scroll into view and are never hidden automatically.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every Board View column, including Unassigned, scrolls vertically on its own when its cards exceed the viewport, while adjacent columns and pinned headers stay visible.
  • The page itself does not scroll vertically; only the content inside each column does.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10046 — Board View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S3-E1, S3-E2 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E1: “Every Board View column, including Unassigned, scrolls vertically on its own when its cards exceed the available viewport, while adjacent columns and pinned headers remain visible. The page itself does not scroll vertically; only the content inside each column does.”
  • S3-E2: “Allow horizontal scrolling when technician columns exceed the available viewport; never hide technicians automatically.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
